lead_tracking.description: When a lead calls in with a referral code, log it here. The code links back to the referrer for commission calculation at closing.

flyer_spec.paper: 24lb bright color (hot pink, neon green, safety orange, goldenrod)
design_requirements: Referrer name/phone field (blank line with 'Referred by: ________')
Headline: 'Facing Foreclosure? Free Consultation — No Obligation'
Subhead: '30+ Years Experience • All Options Explained • Keep or Sell'
Back side: brief FAQ + 'What happens if I do nothing?'

compliance_notes: Referrer must NOT claim to be an attorney, lender, or government representative.
Referrer must NOT promise specific outcomes (e.g., 'they will stop your sale').
Referrer is an independent contractor, not an employee or agent of Biscayne Solutions Group.
Commission paid only on closed transactions — no upfront referral fees (RESPA safe harbor).
All referral activity logged for potential FDCPA/MARS audit trail.
Referrer agreement (separate legal doc) required before cards distributed.
